verses.pali: Yo dhammaṁ deseti so atthappaṭisaṁvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṁvedī ca.
verses.english: When the teacher understands the meaning and the teaching.

verses.pali: Yo dhammaṁ suṇāti so atthappaṭisaṁvedī ca hoti dhammappaṭisaṁvedī ca.
verses.english: When the audience understands the meaning and the teaching.

verses.pali: Yo ceva dhammaṁ deseti yo ca dhammaṁ suṇāti ubho atthappaṭisaṁvedino ca honti dhammappaṭisaṁvedino ca.
verses.english: When both the teacher and the audience understand the meaning and the teaching.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi ṭhānehi kathā pavattinī hotī”ti.
verses.english: These are the three situations in which conversation flows.”
